description: The Tail actions the app has, on its own routes, for this account. Public posts, deletes and reports send nothing until body.confirmation carries the app's literal: first call returns the preview; show it, get the customer's yes, then call again. reply: POST tail/posts/{postId}/replies {text} (confirmation PUBLISH_REPLY); remove_reply: POST tail/replies/{replyId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_REPLY); like: POST tail/posts/{postId}/like {active}; bookmark: POST tail/posts/{postId}/bookmark {active}; pin: POST tail/posts/{postId}/pin {active}; vote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/vote {choice: place|pass|null}; repost: POST tail/posts/{postId}/repost {active}; quote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/quotes {expectedRevision, text} (confirmation PUBLISH_QUOTE); poll_vote: POST tail/posts/{postId}/poll-vote {option 0-3}; relation: POST tail/relations {profileId, kind follow|mute|block, active}; list_create: POST tail/lists {name, description} (confirmation CREATE_LIST); list_edit: POST tail/lists/{listId} {expectedRevision, name, description}; list_member: POST tail/lists/{listId}/members {profileId, active}; list_remove: POST tail/lists/{listId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_LIST); report_post: POST tail/reports {postId, reason, details} (confirmation REPORT_POST); report_reply: POST tail/replies/{replyId}/report {reason, details} (confirmation REPORT_REPLY); report_profile: POST tail/profiles/{profileId}/report {reason, details} (confirmation REPORT_PROFILE); delete_post: POST tail/posts/{postId}/remove (confirmation DELETE_POST); profile_edit: POST tail/profile {expectedRevision, displayName, bio, settings}; claim_handle: POST account/handle {handle (3-20 of a-z 0-9 _), displayName, bio?, settings: {visibility: public|hidden, rankVisibility: auto|on|off}} (confirmation CREATE_PROFILE); profile_photo: POST tail/profile/photo {expectedRevision, photo: {mime image/jpeg|image/png, base64} or null}.
